    • zip

      @NotNull @Contract("_, _ -> new") public static <T> SamePair.ZipResult<T> zip(@NotNull List<T> ls, @NotNull List<T> list)
      Attempts to zip 2 lists of the same type T to a single list of zips where each element yada yada bruv essentially: 
      List<Integer> A = List.of(1, 2, 3);
List<Integer> B = List.of(4, 5, 6);

ZipResult result = zip(A, B);
ArrayList<SamePair<Integer>> pairs;
if (result.isSuccessful())
     pairs = result.getSecond();

// pairs holds:
// SamePair(1, 4)
// SamePair(2, 5)
// SamePair(3, 6)
      Type Parameters:
      T - The type everything finna hold
      Parameters:
      ls - The first list
      list - The second list
      Returns:
      A new ZipResult
